description: Data4Business Date Picker is a lightweight, fully customizable date-range slicer for Power BI. Give report users a clean calendar control to filter by a custom From/To range or a single click on a predefined period. Key features: - Predefined quick ranges: current period, current year, year-to-last-month, last weekend, last week, last month, last year - Custom From/To date selection - Choose which quick ranges appear in the picker - Full styling: button colors for default/hover/pressed states, text and icon colors, popup background, border color/width, corner radius, and font family/size/bold/italic/underline - Selected-period highlight and hover states - Responsive layout that adapts to the visual's size - Available in English and Dutch, following the Power BI display language - No external services — all filtering happens inside your report Ideal for finance, operations, and any report where users need fast, intuitive date filtering.
